#### `def decide_user_install(use_user_site, prefix_path, target_dir, root_path, isolated_mode)` (Línea 668)
- **Propósito:** Determine whether to do a user install based on the input options.

If use_user_site is False, no additional checks are done.
If use_user_site is True, it is checked for compatibility with other
options.
If use_user_site is None, the default behaviour depends on the environment,
which is provided by the other arguments.
- **Firma:** `def decide_user_install(use_user_site, prefix_path, target_dir, root_path, isolated_mode)`
